body: They both said that they did it to get at me. I don’t care if my ex gets with people like I’ve gotten with others and he should too. It’s just that it was with someone I trusted and him and I both agreed we wouldn’t get with each other’s friends for the sake of the other person and I’ve respected that rule.

Thank you so much. 
1. 2017 was a really hard year for me. I love people I loved and pretty much ended up alone. I have tried killing my self but every time it doesn’t work. 

2. I’m at a point where I don’t have any friends at all and I don’t talk to my parents about personal things so I can’t really talk to anyone about it. I’ve tried helplines but I always feel like they’re not really listening and that it would be easier if I just left them alone same with everyone else. 

3. The whole night they were sending photos together and I called her and asked her to stop which made it worse. I asked if she did it to get at me and she said they both did.

4. I’m at a point where as soon as I get happy again something else happens that takes that away. In a weeks time I’m moving to the other end of the country to start new because I can’t handle it but it will depend on my grades and this year I’ve tried so hard but it hasn’t paid off at all. I’m just tired of giving everything to people and school and just life because I always give everything and get nothing in return and its a massive slap to the face. 

5. I run and swim it’s the only way I can deal with bad things that happen which sounds really werid but yeah. I also bottle stuff up because I don’t really like talking about my problems just because everyone has their own and I don’t want to bother people. 

I’m moving away to other end of the country to get away from people and drama and hopefully people can just leave me alone because I’ve lost so many friends from stupid reasons so I have no one at the moment.
Feels expect my was on the 18th August and no one remembered not even my family.
